scope.execution: single chronological traversal; rotate seven-policy execution order by global frame index modulo 7
scope.warmup: 10 synthetic zero-image forwards per model before exposure, excluded and counted separately
scope.inference: synchronized transfer-in + model forward + transfer-out, actual calls for every policy; no prediction lookup cache
scope.scheduler: reset/decision and fresh risk-cache update; compute = inference + scheduler
scope.shared: RGB/depth file I/O and decode/resize measured once per frame; shared among policies
scope.excluded: model/setup/warmups, offline metrics/events and CSV writes excluded from per-policy compute
scope.wall: whole traversal wall time includes shared preparation, all seven policies, scoring and logging; not a single-policy end-to-end benchmark
scope.limitations: CPU-only available in this runtime; OS cache/load uncontrolled; no energy/battery measurement
